About this module Syllabus Units

Welcome to CSCU9YX : Cyber Security

This module is concerned with computer security principles and securing computer communication in computer networks. Course content will be delivered via a mix of face to face and online sessions together with independent guided study.

All course content can be accessed via links in the schedule table at the top of the Syllabus page. This table will provide links to each topic where you will be able to access the relevant videos and practical sheets.

Recorded lecture material will be made available during semester and then discussed either via Q&A sessions on MS Teams or in person at lectures. Practical material will be made available in advance for you to work on at home and will be supported by on line help sessions where staff can answer any questions you may have or assist you with completing the practicals. There will also be a related tutorial which will give you an opportunity to discuss current security breaches and solve some simple cryptography challenges.

Assessment

Module assessment will be conducted via a a class test that will present you with scenarios for you to analyse and describe the correct method or course of action to use.

Staff

This module will be taught by Dr David Cairns (Module Coordinator).

Software

For the Computer Security related practicals, we will provide a Jupyter Lab terminal that you will be able to use to access the forensics server.

To get you started, make sure you familiarise yourself with some key areas in this module. For example, Syllabus is where you can find key dates and a module outline. Units is the place for information about this module and all your learning content.
